algorithm: conditional DDPM over action sequences (CNN or transformer noise-prediction network), DDIM at inference
arm: UR5 (real Push-T); Franka (real mug flip, pouring/spreading, bimanual tasks); Robomimic's Panda arm (sim)
sim: task-specific: Robomimic (MuJoCo-backed), Push-T (custom 2D physics per IBC), BlockPush (per BET), Franka Kitchen (per Relay Policy Learning); no single engine/timestep stated for the combined benchmark
success_criterion: success rate for most tasks; Push-T uses target-area coverage (IoU of pushed T-block vs goal region), thresholded against the minimum achieved IoU in the human demonstration dataset for the real-world criterion
headline_metric: average success-rate improvement over best baseline (LSTM-GMM, IBC, BET) across 15 tasks / 4 benchmarks
headline_value: 46.9% average improvement (Abstract; Sec. 5; App. B.2 exact calc: avg=0.46858)
human_data: human-teleoperated demonstrations for Robomimic/Push-T/Kitchen/real tasks (200-566 per task); BlockPush uses 1000 scripted-oracle demos with no human data
paper_code_mismatch: the paper's core loss equations (DDPM training loss, EBM/InfoNCE, score-matching) are unrecovered images in the parsed text, and code/md is a signature-only API map, so compute_loss's body could not be verified from code; only the exact shipped noise-scheduler config (DDPMScheduler, 100 train steps) is confirmed.
note_gaps: Core equations (Eq. 1-9) rendered as images and did not survive conversion to text; code/md has class/def signatures and config YAMLs only, no function bodies. No hand/dexterous-manipulation results in this paper itself (included as the shared policy-head architecture for dp3_2024 and umi_2024).
